How do I add a pic to my post title?

Select "Share a Link" instead of "Discuss".

An image itself, however, cannot be included in the actual post title, the text of the post title can only act as a link to the picture.
To expand it further, make sure you're linking directly to an image (ends with .jpg, .png, .gif, etc) and not an album. Voat has some issues expanding images inside an album (imgur, slimgur, etc).

Oh, I misunderstood you a little bit. You mean how to include that picture preview to the left of your post title, correct?

@no_censorship_bruh is right; linking directly to an image is better than an image within an album.

What about the preview image on the left of some titles and how some videos can be seen right on the same page without going to Youtube. How can we do that?
You have to link directly to the image or video for it to do that.

So the preview image on the left only shows if the url is a direct link to an image, like a jpg or png; if you link to an album of images, for instance, there will likely be no preview. If the link is a direct link to Youtube then you should be able to view the video in page on Voat, or at least I am guessing, my connection is really slow so I never watch those video or submit them.
